text:
yasmin: Heads-up — support got a report that deep links to /guides/cli#install-⚠️ sometimes land at top of page in Safari. user pasted link: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/cli#install-⚠️

pete: emoji in headings is the classic footgun. our slugifier percent-encodes them -> `install-%EF%B8%8F%E2%9A%A0%EF%B8%8F` which browsers don't always match when callers use the raw emoji. can we see the markdown?

yasmin: page snippet:
```md
## Install ⚠️ (arch-specific)
Run the installer for your platform.

```bash
# quick install (for x86/arm)
curl -fsSL https://install.redwood.ai | sh ⚠️
```

omar: two issues: 1) emoji in heading creates ugly encoded slug, 2) the inline emoji inside a fenced shell snippet sometimes makes our preprocessor think there's unicode noise in the same chunk, leading to inconsistent id generation between local dev and CI builds.

pete: quick fixes: replace emoji with text or add explicit id: `## Install (arch-specific) {#install}`. also remove run-time emoji in code blocks — keep examples ascii-only.

yasmin: i'll open a tiny PR that swaps out emoji, adds explicit id as a belt-and-suspenders, and updates CONTRIBUTING with "avoid emoji in headings". PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4019

doc-bot: PR #4019 opened by @yasmin: "normalize headings: remove emoji, add explicit ids, sanitize code blocks". Requested reviewers: @pete, @omar.

linter-bot: Noted several code blocks in changed files that include non-ASCII glyphs. Suggestion: run `scripts/strip_code_emojis.py` in pre-commit for docs.

ci-bot: Running docs linkcheck for PR #4019 (`yarn docs:linkcheck`, `mkdocs build --strict`). Also running slug-sanitize step.

ci-bot: Linkcheck output: found 1 heading slug containing non-alphanumeric characters: `install-%EF%B8%8F%E2%9A%A0%EF%B8%8F`. Failing w/ suggestion: use `{#install}` or plain ascii heading.

yasmin: updated PR: removed emoji from heading and code block, added `## Install (arch-specific) {#install}` and small note in CONTRIBUTING. Patch diff:
```diff
-## Install ⚠️ (arch-specific)
+## Install (arch-specific) {#install}
@@
-curl -fsSL https://install.redwood.ai | sh ⚠️
+curl -fsSL https://install.redwood.ai | sh
```

ci-bot: Re-running checks on #4019... All link checks and slug-sanitize passed. No new non-ascii slugs in changed files.

pete: LGTM. Merged commit a2d9b4f.

omar: follow-up: i'll add a small rule to the slug-sanitize CI that emits a help message when it detects emoji in headings and prints the suggested `{#explicit-id}`. cheap UX win.

yasmin: adding an entry to the migration guide and CONTRIBUTING: "Avoid emoji/symbols in headings — prefer explicit heading ids for stable deep links."

pete: also FYI, if we want to be fancy we can add a client-side redirect map for common legacy emoji anchors, but i'm fine with docs guidance + CI to stop future regressions.

yasmin: closing the loop. if anyone sees odd deep links with unicode slugs, drop them here or open a quick PR. :thumbsup:
